data.one_liner: Communicate with Zebra DataWedge barcode scanners using the DataWedge Intent API in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that enables communication with Zebra DataWedge scanners on Android via intents. It allows apps to initialize scanners, create profiles, listen to scan results and scanner events on streams, and control scanner actions.
use_when: Building a Flutter application that runs on Zebra Android devices with built-in barcode scanners
Integrating with the Zebra DataWedge Intent API to manage profiles and capture scan results
avoid_when: Targeting non-Android platforms or generic smartphone cameras for barcode scanning without Zebra hardware
Needing a general-purpose cross-platform camera barcode scanner
strengths: Direct integration with Zebra DataWedge APIs and Android intents
Provides streams for scan results, scanner events, and status changes
Supports profile creation and management for DataWedge
weaknesses: Requires specific Zebra hardware running DataWedge
data.setup_notes: Requires Android configuration for Zebra DataWedge and compatible Zebra hardware.
